comment: One of the most caring and kind instructors I have ever the pleasure of learning from. Our entire departments wonders how he was able to make students enjoy physical chemistry as much as we do. He did everything he could for the sake of his students and we are forever grateful for the impact he has had on our lives.
Absolutely love this man.
Great guy!! He’s more though provoking than he is hilarious, but he does tell good jokes every class.

Dr. Abrash is a really nice guy. His teaching is hit or miss and he defintely tends to give way too much confusing and complicating detail which is not, then, always on the tests. He starts each class with a corny dad joke and will call on people throughout the class, but he is encouraging and doesn't expect you to always have the answers.
Dr. Abrash clearly wants his students to succeed and is very accommodating when issues come up!
Very nice professor who explains concepts during lectures very well. Would definitely take him again.

Dr. Abrash is funny, kind & serves as a mentor to his students. He generously posts all of his lecture notes online. The course follows the curriculum of AP chem & is familiar to those who have been exposed. The exams are straight forward, especially if you do the practice tests prior & even so he usually curves the grades.

Dr. Abrash is super knowledgeable and it shows. P. Chem. II is tough and abstract, but Dr. Abrash really tries to make you understand and is super helpful outside of class. His tests are predictable as long as you do his practice tests and even when they're not, he curves very kindly.

Dr. Abrash is super knowledgeable and it shows, P. Chem. is a tough subject regardless of who teaches it, but he really tried and is super helpful outside of class. His tests are fairly predictable as long as you do his practice tests. He curves very kindly too so that's a plus.

ENVR201 is reading-heavy and open-discussion-based, which can be a bit dull at times. However, Professor Abrash is a really nice teacher. He tells a joke at the beginning of each class, and is really personable. Don't be afraid to talk to him about any concerns that you may have: he'll listen.

Abrash was literally so supportive and amazing. If you talk to him he is the sweetest human you will ever meet. He is very passionate and knowledgeable about environmental studies. As long as you do your hw itll be fine! He lets you use summaries if readings on the test. Hes also very understanding about late work. Do your work and youll get A

I really recommend this professor as his lectures are intriguing and clear. If you are interested in chemistry, tests are not difficult to pass, as long as listen carefully in class and finish assignments regularly. If you have any questions, feel free to ask him. He is very approachable and helpful. Feel more love in chemistry!!!
For an international student, Dr Sam helps me fit the life in UR in all aspects. Love the professor! Fun class but you need to follow all the instructions and do homework regularly.

Dr. Abrash is a really nice guy! Not the most interesting or dynamic class but it gets the job done. Test are straight forward and not too hard if you pay attention, study and are prepared. Pretty regular homework but class is not mandatory. Overall positive experience
Explains stuff quickly and not clearly. Its more helpful to not go to class and read his lecture notes that he posts online which he reads off word for word in class.
very helpful, very nice, you really need to keep up with the homework, and study regularly.

Definitely take this to fulfill science requirement--even if you don't know a thing about chem you can do well. He lets you use homework on your tests, gives you old tests to study from, and will tell you what to study in the pre-test study sessions. Very helpful professor & if you do the work, you will do well. Also very relaxed attendance policy.
Abrash is a really nice professor that will help you understand and get through lab in a breeze. He rarely gives A's on lab assignments but you'll end up with an A as long as you do your homework.

He is everything that a professor should be. He gave us handouts at the beginning of class with lots of info and read through them. He cares about students and wants them to do their best. He always wants to help and always knows what he's talking about. I am not a science person, but Dr. Abrash's lab session was bar none the finest.

Prof Abrash is a great guy- always willing to help. For 110, he procided old tests to 5 years back that made studying very simple. He wants you to understand do well, not pound concepts into your brain. He's a quirky guy, but interesting to learn from and he knows his stuff
Had him for physical chem, easily the hardest class I have ever taken. Nice guy and really knows his stuff.
No Comments
